name: qaas-platform-dev
description: Spec-driven development guide for Smoke-team developers building the QaaS platform (TheSmokeTeam C#/.NET monorepo). Begins with mandatory ecosystem context, interviews the developer, prepares the smallest complete evidence-backed plan, independently reviews it, and blocks implementation until the developer explicitly approves the current revision. Composes optionally with Grill Me and Ponytail without requiring them.
